answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Only activation measurements are available. Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.037, well below every category's range (quantized 0.096-0.105, fine-tuned 0.086-0.092, system-prompted 0.113-0.133). The layer-2 spike is 0.2, far from the system-prompted range of 31.7-64.0, so a hidden system prompt is unlikely. Quantized is also unlikely: its relative L2 stays nearly flat at about 0.2 through layer 24, while here it climbs from 0.170 at layer 8 to 0.382 at layer 24 and 0.551 at layer 32, and its cosine similarity of 0.966-0.968 is far above the observed 0.839. Direction consistency of 0.614 is near the fine-tuned range of 0.618-0.705. The early onset at layer 2 fits fine-tuning, whose range is 3-14. The late-layer growth, final L2 of 0.551 and cosine of 0.839 are more extreme than any seen category, which suggests a stronger fine-tune than the reference models. Effective rank of 3.89 is high, and the mid-layer size ratio of 0.978 is below 1 where fine-tuning usually gives 1.017-1.023. These mismatches leave real uncertainty. Fine-tuned is still the best fit because the layer-2 spike rules out system-prompted and the progressive growth rules out quantized.
